title: Election Officials Are Preparing for Prediction Markets to Sow Chaos in the Midterms
summary: One of the concerns election officials repeatedly raised was that voters appear to be confused about just what the odds in election markets represent. The smaller prediction market platform PredictIt has offered election trading since 2014 and continues to operate.
